tagData.title: pricing-tables
tagData.name: Pricing Tables
tagData.description: Pricing tables are a great way of presenting the customer with the various plans and prices for a product or service. They present information in an easy-to-read and quick-to-process format and also serve as a comparison tool. The table displays what is available, how much it costs, and what benefits come with each plan, making it easier for customers to decide which one is right for them.
